increment_paragraph: **OUT-SLOT-MEMBER-THEN-FRESH** (USER DECISION 2026-11-28: option (a), declare the op's member custody; no rule, Lean or contract change; [report](../../reports/out-slot-member-then-fresh/README.md)). The custody claim is true in both bodies: `rd_kafka_assignment`/`rd_kafka_subscription` move `rko_u.assign.partitions`/`rko_u.subscribe.topics` into the caller's slot and null the member before `rd_kafka_op_destroy`, whose `GET_ASSIGNMENT`/`GET_SUBSCRIPTION` arm would otherwise free the copy the cgrp handler stored. The existing vocabulary cannot state it: a result state needs `resource_return_owned(nonnull)` while `rd_kafka_op_req2` is nullable (`quant-live-unbacked`); a result member maps only to `#absent` or a function designator (`quant-live-value`), and C04.19.6's `#moved` never hands to the caller; route G gives a member read no identity, even one the frame linked (`UnknownAlias`); and no C04.13 disposition covers the non-zero exits (unwritten, or the moved member). The card stops with options ((a1) new member-custody vocabulary plus a move-out reading, rule 96, Lean; (a1)+(b); (a2) the frame-linked move-out alone; (c)) and lands four pins of these refusals in `op_constructor_declarations.rs`. Even a stated custody moves neither row: the status does not partition the early unwritten exits, the callee rows keep rule 74l's slot refusal, and no compiled caller passes a known-null slot. MEASUREMENT_SENTENCE GATE_SENTENCE

ledger.text: OUT-SLOT-CONDITIONAL-DELIVERY (rule 85(4)) refused rdkafka_subscription.c rd_kafka_assignment and rd_kafka_subscription: the slot first takes rko->rko_u.….partitions/topics, then a fresh list only when that is NULL and err is 0, and the early returns of RD_KAFKA_RESP_ERR__UNKNOWN_GROUP/__TIMED_OUT leave it unwritten while `return err` can return the same codes. USER DECISION 2026-11-28 chose option (a). OUT-SLOT-MEMBER-THEN-FRESH verified the claim true (the member is nulled before rd_kafka_op_destroy, whose arm 24/23 frees it; the cgrp handler stores a copy into the request op it replies with) but found it unstatable: (1) C04.19.4 admits a result state only beside resource_return_owned(nonnull), and rd_kafka_op_req2 is nullable (quant-live-unbacked); (2) a result member maps only to #absent or a function designator (quant-live-value), and C04.19.6's #moved never hands to the caller; (3) route G reads `X = P->M` as a borrowed alias with no identity, even for a member the frame linked (see CARRIED-CHILD-TEARDOWN-AFTER-UNLINK, O04-READ-BOUND); (4) no C04.13 disposition covers the non-zero exits (unwritten or the moved, possibly null member). Pinned in crates/qcore-c-gateway/tests/op_constructor_declarations.rs. Options: (a1) new vocabulary for a received object's owned member (a result state on a nullable result, a member value holding an owned possibly-null object under the decided discriminant) plus a route G move-out reading (rule 96), Lean parity; (a1)+(b), the only combination that gives a known-null caller a reading; (a2) the frame-linked move-out reading alone; (c) keep the refusal as final. None moves either row (no compiled caller passes a known-null slot; the callee rows keep rule 74l and their access leaves). USER DECISION needed. DISCHARGE: implement the chosen option with Lean parity, or record (c) as final; re-measure the two rows.
